spanish: Y anduvieron hijos de Majir hijo de Manasés a Giladah, y la tomaron, y desalojó al amorreo que en ella.

findings.issue: Proper name plus directional suffix. Locked form is Galaad; Giladah hebraizes it (Gilad) and keeps the suffix inside the name. The suffix is already rendered by a.

notes: Other clauses match number, person, hiphil singular, gentilic singular, and the verbless relative.
